name: ProcessGitRunner::run

test_list.description: Validated argv reaches Git directly without shell interpolation.
Process environment disables implicit execution and EOL conversion.
A slow or noisy child is bounded and terminated.
Error reporting does not return unbounded output or secret content.

inputs.name: argv
inputs.description: Fixed Git argv with validated ref and path values.

output_description: Bounded stdout, exit status, and bounded stderr for internal callers.
